limits: oracleProxy = markClose / (1 + hourly funding premium) approximates the historical oracle; candle close approximates the mark; 5m steps; one arb per pool per step; parameters are the spec defaults, not tuned.
liquidity: identical per pool: 1,000 base on the base side, range ~-50%/+50% around the start price
method: Each step: warp to the candle, set mock oracle = oracleProxy and mark = candle close (perp 0); perp 1 = the same values ~lagSec earlier, linearly interpolated between candles (1m data not served). Arb agent = Arena bot algorithm, profit at the true oracle, unprofitable trades reverted. Seeded retail agent, same sequence on every pool. LP value = position principal + collected fees at the oracle; HODL = initial tokens at the oracle; LVR = HODL - LP value.
